title: Enforce rizzstack.brief/1 in hyvv when brief_mode is enforce (separate from ticket_mode; owner-dated)

outcome.summary: The enforcement half of wave B on the hyvv side, shipped dark behind its own switch. A new `brief_mode` setting (off|report|enforce) governs rizzstack.brief/1 at POST /v1/attempts and defaults to `report`, which is B4's behaviour: validate, record brief_validation, always accept. `off` records no brief validation. `enforce` refuses a brief whose v1 validation fails or that carries an undeclared field, with 400 invalid_brief and the validator's problems in the error body, before any attempt row or sandbox is created. `ticket_mode` is NOT touched: it keeps its C2/C4 contract (default off, accepts off|report, refuses enforce at load). Switching brief_mode to enforce is a separate owner act, taken no earlier than 48 hours after B4, B5a and B5b are all on main with zero false positives in the report-only telemetry.
observable_behavior: With brief_mode off or report, an invalid v1 brief is accepted exactly as B4 shipped the report path (no refusal, and off records no brief_validation).
With brief_mode enforce, an invalid v1 brief is refused with 400 invalid_brief, carries the validator problems, and creates no attempt row.
With brief_mode enforce, a valid v1 brief is accepted and records brief_validation.status valid.
With brief_mode enforce, an unversioned brief is accepted and recorded unversioned (B4's legacy path is not retroactively broken).
load_config defaults brief_mode to report, accepts off|report|enforce, and refuses any other value with ValueError.
ticket_mode is unchanged from C2/C4: it still defaults to off, accepts off|report, and refuses enforce at load_config.

interfaces.name: launcher.load_config brief_mode
interfaces.notes: New setting: accepts off|report|enforce; default report; any other value raises ValueError. ticket_mode is not modified.

interfaces.name: POST /v1/attempts
interfaces.notes: New refusal 400 invalid_brief only when brief_mode is enforce; body carries problems from the vendored validator; no attempt row on refusal. report keeps B4's accept-and-record behaviour; off records no brief_validation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: brief_mode off and report still accept an invalid v1 brief, unchanged from B4 (no refusal path)
brief_mode enforce refuses an invalid v1 brief with 400 invalid_brief, the validator problems and no attempt row
brief_mode enforce accepts a valid v1 brief and records it valid
brief_mode enforce still accepts an unversioned brief and records it unversioned
brief_mode defaults to report, accepts off|report|enforce, and refuses an unknown value at load_config
ticket_mode is untouched: it still defaults to off and still refuses enforce at load_config

with brief_mode=enforce, a brief whose brief_validation.status is unavailable is refused (fail closed) with 503 brief_validation_unavailable and no attempt row; report and off never refuse on unavailability

dependencies: B4 (wave-b-b4) landed as ff523658c7028e09eaef429fee820a140a392140 (attempt att_61a7101a71dc4094, contract 0f8e6f5c): the vendored validator, the schemas, the public attempt-schema declaration and brief_validation on the attempt record

hyvv#103 landed as 4af770af2ad563933bb8850c3d54fdb2da5d9ebc: brief_validation.status is 'unavailable' (not 'invalid') when the vendored validator or brief schema cannot load, and problem messages never echo field values

B6 RED 20e85a4773870c93639f51385d9b37200be970e4 is cut from current hyvv main 4af770af (B4 and #103 merged; C4 ticket_mode default/off-enforce refusal) so AC-006 pins the shipped ticket surface; the implementation starts from this RED and needs no further main merge
B8 (bundlebees #314, merged a9828b75) has stopped emitting brief-schema drift

owner decision: the brief_mode=enforce switch is taken no earlier than 48h after B4, B5a and B5b are all on main and the report-only telemetry shows zero false positives; this slice merges dark (default report) and the switch is configuration, not a code change
RED commit 20e85a4773870c93639f51385d9b37200be970e4 adds only tests/test_brief_enforce.py over main 4af770af; the B6 delta is test-only
assumptions: brief_mode is per-host configuration (config.json), not an environment variable
the refusal happens before attempt insertion so a refused submit has no journal row
signature verification stays out of scope (C4/C5): this slice enforces the schema only
off records no brief_validation; report is the default so B4's behaviour is unchanged without configuration
ticket_mode is owned by C2/C4 and is neither widened nor read by this slice

reasons: turns a report into a refusal on the admission path every bee crosses
a mis-scoped enforce breaks every dispatch on the host that enables it
risk.blast_radius: every bundled dispatch on any host configured with brief_mode=enforce
